_comment: Example only. Copy to C:\ProgramData\agent-007\config\config.json and edit every CHANGE-ME value. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Secrets (bot token, LM Studio token, Strata key) never go in this file: deploy\new-secrets.ps1 writes them to secrets.json.

telegram._comment: UI-4: your numeric Telegram user id (scripts\whoami-telegram.ts prints it). Replace the placeholder.

model._comment: runner is lmstudio or strata (decided at Gate G0, UI-10). Both blocks may stay. Every baseUrl must be loopback.

folders._comment: UI-1: the folders the agent may read, list and search ({alias, absolute path}). UI-2: paths to deny (Pixotope and work data); a deny always wins. Both lists are yours to fill in; nothing is pre-filled.

paths._comment: The agent data root is under the agent user's profile. Change agent007 here if you used another account name.

mcp._comment: Phase 2 (S9.4). creative-hub MCP servers the agent may call. Every MCP tool is deferred (found through tool_search); allowTools is the allowlist, anything else a server lists is dropped. Every url must be http on 127.0.0.1 or localhost. Leave servers empty until you list them. book-translator is not listed by default (it needs a bearer token, I20).

jobs._comment: Phase 2. ipcPort is the job runner's loopback port (the job runner reads the same value from its own jobrunner.json). approvalTimeoutSec is the Telegram approval timeout for a job or an in-job permission (it rejects on expiry). progressIntervalSec is the minimum time between edits of the progress message.

flow._comment: Phase 2. The id (in mcp.servers) of the Flow music/video server. The Flow guard blocks any call without max_credits and any call outside an approved Flow job (D11).

tools._comment: Phase 2. Nothing to configure: the always-loaded tool list is a code constant (exactly 10, I27) and config cannot add to it. Every other tool is deferred behind tool_search.

secondOpinion._comment: Phase 2, OFF and unbuilt unless you explicitly say yes (UI-15, I23): it is a cloud call by the agent outside a job. baseUrl must be loopback; the port comes from the proxy's own settings (U52).

_presets_claude._comment: MA2. NOTHING reads this block: presets live in security.json (settings UI, Models form, which also shows these as templates). Claude through the proxy uses the SUBSCRIPTION login only; the setup check and /status refuse the preset when the proxy reports auth_method api_key. Set contextWindow and maxTokens by hand (U52). The Claude preset needs termsAccepted.claude, ticked only in the Terms form (I41). autoFallback stays false: Claude is a brain, never a fallback.

_bots._comment: Phase 4 (S20). NOTHING reads this block: bots live in security.json, which only the settings UI writes (never config.json). It shows the ONE bot a new install has, main (the existing agent), to enter in the settings UI after you run scripts\migrate-bots (it copies the Phase 1 to 3 state into bots\main and leaves the old files). Without a bots section the install behaves exactly as before. More bots are added in the UI, each with its own token (deploy\new-secrets.ps1 -Bots <id>), route, tool allowlist, folders (inside the folders above, never overlapping folders.deny) and edges. A bot with no edge has no ask_bot and no list_bots; at most one bot may have shell; a bot with a proxy preset in its route reads only its cloudSafeRoots unless you relax that in the UI.
